page.layout: One printed page, single column of text, dedication opening with a decorative band and title block; no margin notes. Signature "a 2" at the foot left.

main_text.head: Illustrissimis & Celsissimis Principibus ac Dominis,
Dn. HERMANNO, Dn. FRIDERICO, Dn. CHRISTIANO, Dn. ERNESTO,
Hassiae Landgraviis, Comitibus in Catzenelnbogen, Dietz, Ziegenhain & Nidda &c.
main_text.p: Illustrissimi & Celsissimi Principes, ac Domini, Domini Clementissimi. Lilium inter spinas sponsa est, inter spinas rosa Ecclesia est: spinis septa undiq;, sive defendatur his undiq;, sive petatur iis undiq;. Non caret ea tutela & defensione suâ, nec poterit absq; dolore impune quisquam tangere, si discerpere & devastare velit eam. Quod Saul audiebat minas spirans & cades: Saul, Saul, quid me persequeris, durum est tibi contra stimulum calcitrare: Idem audiunt hodie quoq; hostes Ecclesiae omnes

page.notes: Decorative woodcut band at the top is not transcribed as text. The title block is set in mixed roman and italic type with black letter-like swash forms; "Hassiae" reads as printed "Hassiæ". Some words in the body are partly obscured by show-through and stains (e.g. "tangere", "calcitrare" uncertain). Final line "omnes" is the catchword, which also appears as the last word of the text; treated as catchword only.
